verdict.rationale: Formant documents first-party webhooks that make an HTTP API call to any endpoint when a Formant event fires, which is a registrable outbound callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single doc sentence with no detail on setup or delivery behavior. Missing for 10: payload schema, signing/authentication, retry and delivery guarantees, programmatic (API-based) webhook registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
